system.special: <p><strong><p><strong>&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;Lightning Bolt: </strong> </strong> &lt;/strong&gt; Every 5 rounds in a storm; damage equals remaining HP (save vs. spells halves it).&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;Immunity: Lightning does not affect storm giants.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;Thrown Boulders: 3d6 damage; range 150/300/450 yards.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/p&gt;</p></p>
system.description: Storm giants are over 22 feet tall with bronze skin and red or yellow hair. They love thunderstorms, can create one in a turn, and in a storm may throw a lightning bolt every five rounds for damage equal to their remaining hit points.
